sections.title: Dates and Months
sections.content: Dates work to one pattern in Spanish — 'el' plus the number plus 'de' plus the month, with no capital letter on the month: el doce de mayo. It's exactly how you'll say when your birthday is.

items.spanish: Mi cumpleaños es el doce de mayo.
items.english: My birthday is on the twelfth of May.

items.spanish: Carlos sale temprano para comprar un pastel.
items.english: Carlos goes out early to buy a cake.

items.spanish: El mes próximo es mi cumpleaños.

sections.content: A date needs no 'on' in Spanish — 'el doce de mayo' already means on the twelfth.
